title: Boot Camps
subtitle: 「密集訓練營／速成訓練課程／紀律訓練營」，必須按訓練目的和形式分清。
description: 「密集訓練營／速成訓練課程／紀律訓練營」，必須按訓練目的和形式分清。

words.example: The athletes attended an intensive training camp before the tournament.
words.exampleZh: 運動員在比賽前參加密集訓練營。

exercises.original: The athletes joined a boot camp before the national tournament.
exercises.zh: 運動員在全國賽事前參加密集訓練營。
exercises.upgrade: The athletes joined an intensive training camp before the national tournament.

options.explanation: athletes + before tournament 顯示短期集中訓練，與 boot camp 最接近。
夏令營可偏休閒／教育，沒有必然高強度訓練。
主要是講解與討論，不符合運動員密集操練。
偏休息、反思或團隊交流，強度和目的不同。
是迎新介紹，不是賽前訓練。
是工作實習，不適用運動訓練。

exercises.original: The company sent new recruits to a week-long boot camp.
exercises.zh: 公司安排新員工參加為期一星期的密集訓練營。
exercises.upgrade: The company sent new recruits to a week-long intensive training camp.

options.explanation: 太寬泛，沒有 week-long intensive 的集中訓練感。
new recruits + week-long 集中培訓非常吻合。
只介紹環境／規則，不等於高強度訓練。
不以技能密集訓練為核心。

exercises.original: The dancers completed a demanding boot camp before the performance season.
exercises.zh: 舞蹈員在演出季前完成高強度訓練營。
exercises.upgrade: The dancers completed a demanding intensive training camp before the performance season.

options.explanation: 一般 workshop 可能只有短時段，未必能表達 demanding camp。
demanding + performance preparation 明確是密集訓練。
太寬泛，也不一定高強度。

words.meaning: 密集培訓計劃；密集訓練課程
words.example: The company runs an intensive training programme for new analysts.
words.exampleZh: 公司為新入職分析員提供密集培訓計劃。

exercises.original: The firm runs a boot camp for new data analysts.
exercises.zh: 公司為新數據分析員開辦密集培訓計劃。
exercises.upgrade: The firm runs an intensive training programme for new data analysts.

options.explanation: corporate analyst training 不必有實體營地，programme 是最自然正式改寫。
不足以表達整套密集訓練。
實習是工作經驗，不是集中培訓。

exercises.original: The coding boot camp lasts eight weeks and runs full time.
exercises.zh: 程式設計密集課程為期八星期，全日制進行。
exercises.upgrade: The intensive training programme lasts eight weeks and runs full time.

options.explanation: 文法可行但太一般，沒有 full-time intensive training 的精確度。
eight weeks + full time 很符合密集技能培訓。
一般不會全日制八星期。
不會持續八星期全日技能訓練。

exercises.original: Graduates enter a boot camp before starting client work.
exercises.zh: 畢業生在開始客戶工作前先參加密集培訓計劃。
exercises.upgrade: Graduates enter an intensive training programme before starting client work.

options.explanation: 只介紹公司／程序，不足以表達高密度技能培訓。
是實際工作經驗，不是工作前集中培訓。
before client work 表示正式密集準備。

words.example: She completed an intensive course in web development.
words.exampleZh: 她完成了網頁開發密集課程。

exercises.original: She enrolled in a coding boot camp to change careers.
exercises.zh: 她報讀程式設計密集課程以轉職。
exercises.upgrade: She enrolled in an intensive coding course to change careers.

options.explanation: enrolled + career change + coding 非常適合密集課程。
不表示成人轉職技能培訓。
不足以提供完整轉職技能。
不是先學技能的集中課程。

exercises.original: The language boot camp covered six months of material in four weeks.
exercises.zh: 語言密集課程用四星期完成六個月內容。
exercises.upgrade: The intensive language course covered six months of material in four weeks.

options.explanation: 太一般，無法突出四星期完成六個月內容的強度。
compressed material + short period 正是 intensive course。
不適合連續四週技能學習。
可能有語言活動，但不一定密集課程。

exercises.original: The design boot camp gives beginners a fast introduction to the field.
exercises.zh: 設計密集課程讓初學者快速入門。
exercises.upgrade: The intensive design course gives beginners a fast introduction to the field.

options.explanation: 也可能，但如果是一整套 boot camp 課程，intensive course 更完整。
偏講授討論，不足以表達完整技能訓練。

words.example: The team begins its training camp next Monday.
words.exampleZh: 球隊下星期一開始訓練營。

exercises.original: The football club begins its boot camp next week.
exercises.zh: 足球會下星期開始訓練營。
exercises.upgrade: The football club begins its training camp next week.

options.explanation: football club 的集中訓練最自然就是 training camp。
球隊不會以研討會取代賽前操練。
過於學術化，也不符合球隊語境。

exercises.original: The runners attended a high-altitude boot camp.
exercises.zh: 跑手參加高海拔訓練營。
exercises.upgrade: The runners attended a high-altitude training camp.

options.explanation: 沒有運動員高海拔專項訓練含義。
high-altitude + runners 是典型運動訓練營。
不是主要為高強度跑步訓練。

exercises.original: The national team used the boot camp to improve fitness and teamwork.
exercises.zh: 國家隊利用訓練營改善體能和團隊合作。
exercises.upgrade: The national team used the training camp to improve fitness and teamwork.

options.explanation: 可能有 team-building，但 fitness training 顯示 training camp 更精準。
national team + fitness + teamwork 完全吻合。

words.example: The workshop gave beginners a crash course in data analysis.
words.exampleZh: 工作坊為初學者提供數據分析速成課程。

exercises.original: The boot camp gave beginners the basics of cybersecurity in three days.
exercises.zh: 密集速成班在三天內教初學者網絡安全基礎。
exercises.upgrade: The crash course gave beginners the basics of cybersecurity in three days.

options.explanation: basics + three days 明確是快速入門課程。
可以討論網安，但未必系統教授基礎技能。
不可能只三天作技能速成。
只作介紹，不是網安技能學習。

exercises.original: The finance boot camp teaches non-specialists the essentials in one weekend.
exercises.zh: 金融速成班在一個週末教非專業人士基本知識。
exercises.upgrade: The finance crash course teaches non-specialists the essentials in one weekend.

options.explanation: 太一般，沒有 one weekend + essentials 的速成意味。
essentials in one weekend 是典型 crash course。
研討會未必提供系統速成訓練。

exercises.original: The boot camp was designed as a quick introduction to public speaking.
exercises.zh: 這個密集班設計成公開演說快速入門課。
exercises.upgrade: The crash course was designed as a quick introduction to public speaking.

options.explanation: 也可能是實作形式，但 quick introduction 更直接指 crash course。

words.meaning: 加速課程；快速培訓計劃
words.example: The college offers an accelerated programme in software development.
words.exampleZh: 學院提供軟件開發加速課程。

exercises.original: The software boot camp covers the standard curriculum in half the usual time.
exercises.zh: 軟件密集課程以一半正常時間完成標準課程。
exercises.upgrade: The accelerated programme covers the standard curriculum in half the usual time.

options.explanation: half the usual time 明確強調加速完成。

exercises.original: The boot camp lets learners qualify much faster than the normal route.
exercises.zh: 密集課程讓學員比一般途徑更快取得資格。
exercises.upgrade: The accelerated programme lets learners qualify much faster than the normal route.

options.explanation: 通常太短，未必足以完成資格培訓。
much faster than normal route 正是 accelerated。

exercises.original: Students enter a boot camp that compresses twelve weeks of study into six.
exercises.zh: 學生參加把十二星期內容壓縮成六星期的加速課程。
exercises.upgrade: Students enter an accelerated programme that compresses twelve weeks of study into six.

options.explanation: 文法可行但失去壓縮進度特色。
不可能自然涵蓋十二星期課程。
compresses 12 weeks into 6 是典型加速安排。

words.meaning: 沉浸式課程；密集沉浸訓練
words.example: The school runs a six-week coding immersion programme.
words.exampleZh: 學校開辦為期六星期的程式設計沉浸式課程。

exercises.original: The coding boot camp requires full-time study and daily project work.
exercises.zh: 程式設計密集營要求全日學習和每天項目實作。
exercises.upgrade: The coding immersion programme requires full-time study and daily project work.

options.explanation: full-time + daily project work 表示高度持續投入。
是工作環境經驗，不等於結構化學習。

exercises.original: The language boot camp surrounds learners with the target language all day.
exercises.zh: 語言密集課程讓學員全天沉浸於目標語言。
exercises.upgrade: The language immersion programme surrounds learners with the target language all day.

options.explanation: 太一般，沒有全天沉浸特色。
target language all day 是 immersion 的核心。
可能住宿，但不等於語言沉浸。

exercises.original: Participants spend six weeks in a boot camp focused entirely on user-interface design.
exercises.zh: 參加者六星期全程集中學習介面設計。
exercises.upgrade: Participants spend six weeks in an immersion programme focused entirely on user-interface design.

options.explanation: six weeks + focused entirely on one field 符合沉浸式學習。

words.example: Participants joined a two-day intensive workshop on presentation skills.
words.exampleZh: 參加者參加了兩天的簡報技巧密集工作坊。

exercises.original: The two-day boot camp focused on hands-on presentation practice.
exercises.zh: 兩天密集營集中進行簡報實作練習。
exercises.upgrade: The two-day intensive workshop focused on hands-on presentation practice.

options.explanation: two-day + hands-on practice 是典型密集工作坊。
研討會偏講解／討論，實作強度較低。

exercises.original: The writing boot camp lasted one weekend and included repeated drafting exercises.
exercises.zh: 寫作密集班為期一個週末，包括反覆改稿練習。
exercises.upgrade: The intensive writing workshop lasted one weekend and included repeated drafting exercises.

options.explanation: 可以，但 weekend + repeated hands-on exercises 更像 workshop。
實作、短期、反覆修改高度吻合。
寫作 retreat 可存在，但通常強調創作時間／環境，不一定密集指導。

exercises.original: The leadership boot camp uses role-play and practical exercises throughout the day.
exercises.zh: 領袖訓練密集工作坊全天採用角色扮演和實作練習。
exercises.upgrade: The intensive leadership workshop uses role-play and practical exercises throughout the day.

options.explanation: role-play/practical exercises 全日進行，較不像一般研討會。
可能有團隊活動，但不必然是密集技能訓練。
全天實作、角色扮演非常符合 workshop。

words.example: The charity offers a skills training programme for job seekers.
words.exampleZh: 慈善機構為求職者提供技能培訓計劃。

exercises.original: The charity runs a boot camp for unemployed adults learning digital skills.
exercises.zh: 慈善機構為失業成年人開辦數碼技能培訓計劃。
exercises.upgrade: The charity runs a skills training programme for unemployed adults learning digital skills.

options.explanation: unemployed adults + digital skills 是典型就業技能培訓。
不適合成人職業技能語境。
不足以表達實作技能培訓。
需要實際工作崗位，原句沒有。

exercises.original: The boot camp prepares job seekers for entry-level technical roles.
exercises.zh: 密集培訓計劃為求職者準備入門技術職位。
exercises.upgrade: The skills training programme prepares job seekers for entry-level technical roles.

options.explanation: 只介紹工作環境／規則，不能提供完整技術技能。
job seekers + technical roles 明確是職業技能培訓。
是實務工作經驗，不是培訓計劃本身。

exercises.original: The community centre offers a boot camp in basic workplace skills.
exercises.zh: 社區中心提供基本職場技能密集培訓計劃。
exercises.upgrade: The community centre offers a skills training programme in basic workplace skills.

options.explanation: workplace skills 是非常直接的搭配。

words.example: The programme includes a week-long residential training camp.
words.exampleZh: 計劃包括為期一星期的住宿式訓練營。

exercises.original: Participants stay on site throughout the boot camp.
exercises.zh: 參加者在整個訓練營期間住宿於場地。
exercises.upgrade: Participants stay on site throughout the residential training camp.

options.explanation: stay on site 是決定性線索，明確表示住宿式訓練。
通常不要求住宿，也不一定密集訓練。
也可能住宿，但不一定以訓練為核心。

exercises.original: The leadership boot camp requires trainees to live together for a week.
exercises.zh: 領袖訓練營要求學員共同住宿一星期。
exercises.upgrade: The residential training camp requires trainees to live together for a week.

options.explanation: 可能住宿，但原句是 structured leadership training，而非主要反思／休養。
live together for a week 直接表明住宿式訓練。

exercises.original: The sports boot camp includes accommodation, meals and daily training.
exercises.zh: 運動訓練營包括住宿、膳食和每日訓練。
exercises.upgrade: The residential sports training camp includes accommodation, meals and daily training.

options.explanation: 可能也有住宿，但沒有必然每日密集運動訓練。
accommodation + meals + daily training 完全吻合。

words.example: The programme was described as a discipline camp with strict daily routines.
words.exampleZh: 該計劃被形容為設有嚴格日常作息的紀律訓練營。

exercises.original: The programme was described as a boot camp with strict rules and daily routines.
exercises.zh: 該計劃被形容為設有嚴格規則和日常作息的紀律訓練營。
exercises.upgrade: The programme was described as a discipline camp with strict rules and daily routines.

options.explanation: strict rules + daily routines 顯示重點是紀律塑造。
夏令營不一定嚴格或以紀律為主要目的。
只介紹規則，不會透過長時間日程訓練紀律。

exercises.original: The youth boot camp emphasised discipline, punctuality and responsibility.
exercises.zh: 青少年訓練營強調紀律、守時和責任感。
exercises.upgrade: The youth discipline camp emphasised discipline, punctuality and responsibility.

options.explanation: 可能培養責任感，但不必然以紀律為主。

exercises.original: The boot camp used a highly structured schedule to improve behaviour.
exercises.zh: 這個訓練營以高度結構化日程改善行為。
exercises.upgrade: The discipline camp used a highly structured schedule to improve behaviour.

options.explanation: 結構化日程可能存在，但 behaviour improvement 不是一般 retreat 核心。
介紹規則而非長期行為訓練。
structured schedule + improve behaviour 明確是紀律訓練。

words.example: The fitness programme uses a military-style training camp format.
words.exampleZh: 這個健身計劃採用軍事式訓練營形式。

exercises.original: The fitness boot camp uses drills, strict timing and team exercises.
exercises.zh: 健身訓練營採用操練、嚴格時間管理和團隊訓練。
exercises.upgrade: The fitness programme uses a military-style training camp format with drills, strict timing and team exercises.

options.explanation: drills + strict timing + team exercises 是明確軍事式訓練特徵。
不必然有操練與嚴格紀律。

exercises.original: The boot camp copies military routines without being part of the armed forces.
exercises.zh: 這個訓練營模仿軍事作息，但不屬軍隊。
exercises.upgrade: The military-style training camp copies military routines without being part of the armed forces.

options.explanation: 也可能嚴格，但不一定模仿 military routines。
題目明確說模仿軍事模式但非真正軍隊。

exercises.original: The outdoor boot camp includes early starts, physical drills and team discipline.
exercises.zh: 戶外訓練營包括早起、體能操練和團隊紀律。
exercises.upgrade: The outdoor military-style training camp includes early starts, physical drills and team discipline.

options.explanation: 也可，但 physical drills + team discipline + early starts 更具 military-style 特徵。
三項線索都明確指向軍事式訓練。

words.example: The weekend drill camp focused on fitness and repeated team exercises.
words.exampleZh: 週末操練營集中進行體能和重複團隊練習。

exercises.original: The weekend boot camp focused on repeated fitness drills.
exercises.zh: 週末訓練營集中進行重複體能操練。
exercises.upgrade: The weekend drill camp focused on repeated fitness drills.

options.explanation: repeated fitness drills 是本表達成立的核心語境。

exercises.original: The boot camp used the same basic exercises again and again until everyone improved.
exercises.zh: 訓練營反覆進行同一套基本練習，直至所有人進步。
exercises.upgrade: The drill camp used the same basic exercises again and again until everyone improved.

options.explanation: 也可密集，但 again and again 的反覆操練特色更支持 drill camp。
repeated basic exercises 是 drill 的核心。

exercises.original: The sports boot camp concentrated on drills for speed, balance and coordination.
exercises.zh: 運動訓練營集中進行速度、平衡和協調操練。
exercises.upgrade: The sports drill camp concentrated on drills for speed, balance and coordination.

options.explanation: 太一般，沒有反覆操練特色。

falseSynonyms.zh: 夏令營不等於 boot camp summer camp 通常以休閒、教育、社交或戶外活動為主；boot camp 則強調密集訓練、快速技能發展或嚴格紀律。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A summer camp may be educational or recreational, while a boot camp is usually intensive and training-focused.

falseSynonyms.zh: 一般工作坊不一定是 boot camp workshop 可以只有一兩小時；boot camp 通常更密集、更長或要求更高。只有 intensive workshop 才可能在部分語境接近。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A short workshop is not automatically a boot camp; intensity and duration matter.

falseSynonyms.zh: 一般課程過於寬泛 course 可以持續數月甚至數年，也可以每週只上一課；boot camp 通常短期、密集、集中。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Every boot camp may function as a course, but most courses are not boot camps.

falseSynonyms.zh: 營地／營會過於寬泛 camp 可以是露營、夏令營、宗教營或休閒營；boot camp 有明確訓練或紀律目的。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Camp is a broad category; boot camp adds intensive training or discipline.

falseSynonyms.zh: 研討會不等於密集訓練營 seminar 以講解、討論或學術交流為主，通常不含 boot camp 的高密度實作訓練。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A seminar is discussion- or lecture-oriented; a boot camp is usually practice-intensive.

falseSynonyms.zh: 靜修／退修活動不等於 boot camp retreat 常強調休息、反思、團隊交流或遠離日常環境，不一定是高強度訓練。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A retreat may be reflective or restorative rather than intensive.

falseSynonyms.zh: 迎新／簡介不等於 boot camp orientation 主要幫助新成員了解環境、規則和程序；boot camp 則訓練技能或體能。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Orientation introduces people to a setting; boot camp trains them intensively.

falseSynonyms.zh: 實習不等於密集訓練課程 internship 是在真實工作環境中累積經驗，通常持續較長時間；boot camp 是集中式培訓。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON An internship provides workplace experience; a boot camp provides concentrated training.
